name: Research-grade Tactile Array Sensor
summary: A flexible array sensor family for simultaneous pressure measurements, tactile imaging and spatial pressure research. It supports standard arrays and custom shapes, with stretchable construction and customizable packaging and thickness. Sycsense specifies a 0–2000 kPa detection range.
